defects.description: The glossary term 'firewall' was translated as 'Брандмауэры' instead of the required 'межсетевой экран'.

Grammatical error: the word 'Конфигурация' is used in the nominative case instead of the required dative case ('конфигурации') following the verb 'соответствовали'. Additionally, unnecessary bolding was added.
